changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT rp.role_id, c.id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT role_id FROM m_role_permission) rp INNER JOIN m_role_permission existing ON existing.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN m_permission a ON a.id = existing.permission_id AND a.code = 'APPROVE_CREDITDECISION' INNER JOIN m_permission c ON c.code = 'ACTIVATE_CREDITDECISION_CHECKER' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission x WHERE x.role_id = rp.role_id AND x.permission_id = c.id );

INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM m_role r INNER JOIN m_permission p ON p.code IN ('ACTIVATE_CREDITDECISION', 'ACTIVATE_CREDITDECISION_CHECKER') WHERE r.name = 'Super user' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission x WHERE x.role_id = r.id AND x.permission_id = p.id );
